title: Cake Decorating in Houston
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with food allergies
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join us for a hands-on cake decorating class! Experience the joy of transforming your pre-baked cake into delicious masterpieces, guided by our instructor. This unique class combines skill-building, camaraderie, and the creation of beautifully decorated cakes. From the crumb coat to the final touches, discover the satisfaction of newfound talents to share with loved ones. Make your mark in the sweet world of cake decorating with us!
